_comment: Acknowledgement of support, shown under the hero on the home page and at the foot of the research page. Each entry always shows the sponsor's name and what they funded; that needs nobody's permission and is what NSF and DOE ask for. `file` is OPTIONAL: leave it empty until you have the official logo AND the right to display it (see assets/sponsors/README.md), then set it to e.g. "assets/sponsors/nsf.png" and the logo appears above the name. Set "hidden": true to keep an entry on file without showing it.
